summary: By default, users authenticated through LDAP, SAML or other SSO cannot create OAuth2 tokens and get a 403 Forbidden access_denied error. AAP manages token lifetime independently of the IdP, so a token stays valid after the user is disabled in the IdP until it expires or is revoked.
questions: OAuth2 Tokens cannot be created by users associated with an external authentication provider
